newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Oregon authority 1996A bonds AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Oregon authority 1996A bonds AAA.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it assigned its AAA rating to Oregon Health, Housing, Educational and Cultural Facilities Authority's revenue bonds (GNMA collateralised - Pier Park Project) series 1996A.
S&P said in a statement the rating reflects:
-- Assets consisting of a GNMA mortgage-backed security. Payments of principal and interest on the GNMA security are backed by the full faith and credit of the U.S. government;
-- GNMA securities qualifying as triple-A' eligible collateral under S&P rating criteria; and
-- Sufficiency of payments on the GNMA security to pay debt service on the bonds and fees.

S&P said the GNMA-backed mortgage security is expected to be acquired by April 1, 1998 with acquisition fund proceeds. In the event of nondelivery of the GNMA security by April 1, 1998, either the GNMA acquisition period will be extended or acquisition fund proceeds, in addition to other available funds, will be used to redeem bonds in full on or before April 20,1998.
S&P said in addition to the redemption due to nondelivery of the GNMA security, the bonds also are subject to:
-- Mandatory redemption from prepayments on the GNMA
security due to receipt of FHA insurance benefits;
-- Redemption required by FHA or GNMA;
-- Optional redemptions from prepayments on the mortgage note passed through by GNMA beginning October 1, 2006, Standard & Poor's said.
